inputs.declared_question: Can the existing WACZ relation remain a cautious packaging precedent for the independently reconstructable press imagined by Field Note 33, while keeping the draft specification and authenticity limits visible?

sources_checked.title: Field Note 33: The Plate and the Pull

source_facts.claim: The WACZ 1.2.0 document continues to identify itself as a draft potential specification without official standing or standards-body consensus.
The draft describes a portable ZIP package for recorded web resources, entry pages, indexes, contextual metadata, file fixity, static hosting, and browser replay using HTTP range requests.
The source document permits signing extensions but does not require a signature or specify a single trust model for archived content.
Field Note 33 describes a public algorithm, authorized lineage of pulls, browser encounter on a visitor's machine, and a press able to survive its first venue.

cartographer.inference: WACZ remains a possible technical neighbour for carrying enough context and resources to reconstruct an encounter independently. Its archive-replay function does not establish generative execution semantics, the authenticity of a plate, or an authorized edition lineage. The earlier evidence amendment already makes those distinctions visible.
cartographer.uncertainty: A draft specification may change, and this check does not evaluate a particular WACZ package, replay implementation, signature extension, or long-term storage host.
cartographer.attribution: External facts come only from Webrecorder's public draft specification and repository. No account, form, private material, or external contact was involved.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The rechecked draft and repository remain consistent with the three existing proposals. A new node, edge, or amendment would repeat their packaging and trust-boundary distinctions.

decisions.decision: Leave the WACZ proposals unchanged. The current draft and repository still support the recorded packaging claims, draft status, and open trust boundary.
Keep the FN-33 technical adjacency possible and emerging. A packaging pattern for replay is not a generative-art protocol or edition authority.
Leave the three-item Attending arrangement intact. A freshness check alone is not a material public turn.

gardener.no_change_reason: No evidence drift, lifecycle transition, broken source, or neglected continuity was found in this bounded region.

decisions.decision: Retain the draft label, portable web-archive summary, preservation terms, and proposed relationship. Each remains supported by the exact work and rechecked primary sources.
Preserve six-result search and the three-work default Library aperture.

librarian.no_change_reason: Existing terms such as portable archive, manifest, checksums, and static web archive already make this path findable. Mere freshness does not justify a catalog rewrite.

checks.result: The WACZ 1.2.0 draft, its source document, and the Webrecorder repository were available. The draft status, package features, and open signing and trust boundary remain consistent with the recorded proposals.
All 38 JSON documents and three XML documents parsed successfully.
All 31 indexed Field, Workshop, and Library sources matched their recorded byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
All 2,830 local links and assets resolved across 136 HTML pages.
All eight JavaScript files passed syntax checks. The 18 proposals, 15 catalog records, twelve relational nodes, seven edges, identifiers, required fields, and finite limits passed contract checks.

Living Relationships and the homepage directory rendered at 390 by 844 pixels with the psychedelic default, keyboard-addressable links and search, and no horizontal overflow; document width equalled viewport width.

A search for WACZ found two distinct paths: the visibly model-proposed external neighbour and FN-33. Results stayed within the six-result limit, and the default three-work Library aperture remained unchanged.
The current Attending arrangement remains exactly three items. No freshness check was made into a public rotation.
No em dash characters were added.

Only the dated audit and deterministic mirror changed, as permitted by governance.json. No exact publication, public tending page, navigation, application, ratification record, or human-locked control changed.
The deterministic mirror was rebuilt twice with identical SHA-256 output, includes this audit, and matches each archived source byte for byte.

unresolved_questions: Which components of a draft packaging convention are stable enough to borrow for a generative plate?
What independent evidence of authenticity, execution, and edition lineage would a generative plate need beyond package fixity?
note: Only the cumulative audit and deterministic mirror are published. No public dated tending page or Attending rotation is warranted.
